data.display_address: District One Villas, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional fully upgraded villa in District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Situated on a prime corner plot and just moments from the Crystal Lagoon and clubhouse, this remarkable residence offers luxury, privacy, and contemporary elegance in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.

Originally designed as a 6-bedroom villa, the property has been thoughtfully reconfigured into a spacious 5-bedroom layout, creating larger living spaces and enhanced comfort throughout. Upgraded from shell and core to the highest standards, the villa is offered fully furnished and is ready for immediate occupancy.

Property Features:

• 5 Bedrooms + Maid's Room + Driver's Room
• 7 Bathrooms
• Built-Up Area: 9,900 sq. ft.
• Fully Furnished
• Upgraded from Shell & Core
• Originally 6 Bedrooms, Converted to Spacious 5-Bedroom Layout
• Vastu Compliant
• Two Closed Kitchens
• Private Elevator
• Private Swimming Pool
• Dedicated BBQ and Outdoor Entertainment Area
• Multiple Covered Parking Spaces
• Prime Corner Plot
• Close to the Clubhouse and Crystal Lagoon
• Available Now
• Flexible Payment Terms (1-4 Cheques)

Designed for refined family living, this stunning villa combines expansive interiors, premium finishes, and outstanding amenities, delivering an unrivaled lifestyle experience in District One.

Contact Provident Real Estate today to arrange a private viewing.
